paragraph: Moonachie is a small market, and the numbers show it. Three single-family sales closed over six months at a median of $755,000, with the range running from $585,000 to $780,000. The median is the number to anchor on. Sellers listed at a median of $789,000 and came in at a sale-to-list ratio of about 0.96, so sellers here have generally been okay with waiting for the right buyer rather than pricing to move fast, though a 21-day median days on market says the homes that fit found buyers quickly. With one closing in February and two in June, there is no monthly trend to read. If Moonachie follows the usual Bergen County arc, expect the thinnest closing activity in deep winter and whatever inventory exists to surface in spring. In a town this size, the real constraint isn't competition, it's how few houses come up at all.
